<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->

    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <line x1="318" y1="13" x2="318" y2="18" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="11" x2="323" y2="18" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="9" x2="328" y2="18" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="333" y1="7" x2="333" y2="18" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="13" x2="352" y2="13" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="362" y="7" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="364" y="9" width="15" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#0E0F0C"/>
    <rect x="383" y="11" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#0E0F0C"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="76" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="28,67 21,60 28,53" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <text x="54" y="66" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Choose a category</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="103" x2="370" y2="103" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.12" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="137" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Transaction category</text>
    <text x="20" y="160" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Choose where this payment belongs.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- General selector field -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="191" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#454745">Category</text>
    <rect x="20" y="199" width="350" height="56" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="227" r="13" fill="#CDD0CD"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="227" x2="48" y2="227" stroke="#454745" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="67" y="232" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0E0F0C">General</text>
    <polyline points="342,222 347,227 342,232" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="20" y="274" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Select a category to keep your spending organized.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Dropdown shadow and surface -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="291" width="350" height="438" rx="10" fill="#454745" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="20" y="289" width="350" height="438" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="28" y="297" width="334" height="44" rx="10" fill="#16330014"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="319" r="11" fill="#CDD0CD"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="319" x2="52" y2="319" stroke="#454745" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="68" y="324" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">General</text>
    <polyline points="338,315 343,320 338,325" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    
    <!-- Bills -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="365" r="13" fill="#EDB37E"/>
    <rect x="42" y="358" width="12" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="362" x2="51" y2="362" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="366" x2="51" y2="366" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1"/>

    <line x1="28" y1="391" x2="362" y2="391" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Cash -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="417" r="13" fill="#AFCCA1"/>
    <rect x="41" y="412" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="417" r="2" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="76" y="422" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0E0F0C">Cash</text>
    <line x1="28" y1="443" x2="362" y2="443" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Eating out -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="469" r="13" fill="#92B0EA"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="461" x2="44" y2="477" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.4"/>

    <line x1="47" y1="461" x2="47" y2="467" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="461" x2="52" y2="477" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="76" y="474" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0E0F0C">Eating out</text>
    <line x1="28" y1="495" x2="362" y2="495" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>

    <circle cx="48" cy="521" r="13" fill="#9DDDD5"/>
    <polygon points="43,514 54,521 43,528" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <line x1="28" y1="547" x2="362" y2="547" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>

    <circle cx="48" cy="573" r="13" fill="#FC8D94"/>
    <polyline points="42,572 45,576 53,567" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <line x1="28" y1="599" x2="362" y2="599" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Shopping -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="625" r="13" fill="#7B8ABE"/>
    <polyline points="42,622 44,622 46,631 54,631 56,624 45,624" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="634" r="1.4" fill="#0E0F0C"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="634" r="1.4" fill="#0E0F0C"/>

    <line x1="28" y1="651" x2="362" y2="651" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Transport -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="677" r="13" fill="#FFAA99"/>
    <rect x="41" y="671" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="683" r="1.5" fill="#0E0F0C"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="683" r="1.5" fill="#0E0F0C"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="674" x2="52" y2="674" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-width="1"/>

    <line x1="28" y1="703" x2="362" y2="703" stroke="#0E0F0C" stroke-opacity="0.10" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- More -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="715" r="13" fill="#16330014"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="715" r="1.5" fill="#163300"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="715" r="1.5" fill="#163300"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="715" r="1.5" fill="#163300"/>

  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="776" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <text x="45" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Home</text>

    <rect x="119" y="791" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6A6C6A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="796" x2="138" y2="796" stroke="#6A6C6A" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="129" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Cards</text>
    
    <!-- Payments active -->

    <line x1="207" y1="798" x2="221" y2="798" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="214" y1="791" x2="214" y2="805" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="214" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Payments</text>
    
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="305" cy="794" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#6A6C6A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="305" cy="805" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#6A6C6A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="305" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Profile</text>
    
    <!-- More menu -->
    <circle cx="365" cy="795" r="1.8" fill="#6A6C6A"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="800" r="1.8" fill="#6A6C6A"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="805" r="1.8" fill="#6A6C6A"/>
    <text x="365" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
